value.signature: async fn wait (& mut self) -> Option < Refusal >

review.body: { loop { if let EndState :: Ended (cause) = * self . receiver . borrow_and_update () { break cause ; } if self . receiver . changed () . await . is_err () { break None ; } } }
review.item_premise: The asynchronous span follows each poll and records a closed public end cause on return or cancellation on a dropped wait. The watch receiver retains the first end for a later wait; it lends no statement capability or private diagnostic.
